summary: Comprehensive testing of DataVision SSO authentication flows. Backend APIs all pass (12/12 tests). Frontend login/register pages work correctly. SSO button integration has a bug where clicking 'Continue with DataVision' doesn't properly update the Zustand auth-storage state, preventing successful SSO redirect to dashboard.

integration_issues.issue: SSO button obtains fieldforce_token but doesn't update auth-storage, so navigation to dashboard fails
Same issue - SSO button calls setAuth but Zustand persist middleware doesn't sync before navigation

action_items: Fix FieldForce SSO: After setAuth(), add await/delay before navigate() to allow Zustand persist to sync to localStorage
Fix Survey360 SSO: Same issue - need to ensure auth-storage is updated before navigation
Alternative fix: Use a callback or subscriber pattern to navigate only after store is persisted
critical_code_review_comments: FieldForce AuthPages.jsx line 54-57: setAuth() is called but navigation happens immediately - Zustand persist middleware may not have synced to localStorage yet
The SSO stores token in 'fieldforce_token' (localStorage) but auth check on dashboard uses 'auth-storage' (Zustand persist key) - these should be synchronized

rca_of_the_issue.issue: SSO button click gets token but doesn't redirect to dashboard
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Zustand persist middleware uses async localStorage operations. When setAuth() is called followed immediately by navigate(), the persist hasn't synced to localStorage yet. Dashboard page reads from localStorage and doesn't find auth state.
rca_of_the_issue.evidence: After SSO click: fieldforce_token is present in localStorage, but auth-storage is null. Direct login works because the store state is already synced by the time navigation occurs.
rca_of_the_issue.suggested_fix: Add a small delay or use Zustand's onRehydrateStorage callback to navigate only after persist completes. Or use a Promise-based approach to wait for persist before navigation.
